profileText: a Delegate from Massachusetts; born in Charlestown, Mass., May 27, 1738; attended the public schools; engaged in mercantile pursuits; member of the provincial legislature, 1771-1775; delegate to the Provincial Congress in 1774 and 1775; member of the board of war, 1778-1781; delegate to the Massachusetts state constitutional convention in 1779; served in the Massachusetts state senate in 1780 and 1781; Delegate to the Continental Congress, 1782, 1783, 1786, 1787, and 1789, President of Congress, 1786-1787; delegate to the Federal Constitutional Convention in 1787; signed the U.S. Constitution; delegate to the Massachusetts state constitutional convention which ratified the Federal Constitution in 1788; judge of the court of common pleas from July 1, 1785, until his resignation on May 31, 1796; interested in the purchase and settlement of lands in the Genesee Valley, N.Y.; died in Charlestown, Mass., June 11, 1796; interment in Phipps Street Cemetery.
